seat.note: Open seat: Republican Gov. Ron DeSantis was term-limited; the winner takes office Jan. 5, 2027.

nomineesSource: Chosen in the Aug. 18, 2026 party primaries: U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds won the Republican primary (WEAR/CBS12 report 48.8%, with former Lt. Gov. Jay Collins second at 24.8%; other outlets report 48.7% or 47.8% for Donalds) after Donald Trump endorsed him, and former U.S. Rep. David Jolly won the Democratic primary with 61.6% (WEAR).
